verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe Agent Tasks on GitHub Mobile as giving developers a centralized way to start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks on the go, directly matching the story. Community evidence is from older HN threads unrelated to this specific feature, so there's no independent corroboration or contradiction of the Agent Tasks capability itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the Agent Tasks feature specifically, and detail on task management depth (e.g., cancelling, reviewing agent output) beyond starting/tracking.
